note: Banque Misr's schedule of charges for individual accounts (effective 1 July 2026): a local-currency current account opens with 2,500 pounds and is charged 30 pounds a month when its balance falls below that. Its statement fee per cycle (150 pounds inside Egypt) names no cycle, so it isn't modelled. Read again 2026-10-30: the local-currency current account earns no interest and opens with 2,500 pounds (the reading of the minimum-balance column already made). Not stated in this schedule: overdraft, ATM and transfer fees (in other schedules, not read), what papers opening asks.
